See #32213 and https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/32213#issuecomment-1072045193.

issue_context.title: Wrong result for cast expr when value exceeds range
comments:
This bug has existed for a long time. The oldest version I have tested is v3.0.(Maybe this bug exists on all versions)
So change the severity to major.

I wasted some time comparing the `round` function implementation(a little bit complex) between tidb and MySQL.
I think the bug isn't here.

Finally, I found the bug after comparing the code between https://github.com/mysql/mysql-server/blob/0cd98bdf981583a1cf4cb526581fc16e23bb839b/sql/item_func.cc#L1725-L1751 and https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/e130e522904106ecf9815fdb3aaccad68dcb5ee0/types/datum.go#L1426-L1459.

The root cause is that the judgment of digit length should be after calling `round` function, not before because the decimal may have a longer digit length after calling `round`.

review_comments: Maybe some comments? Round away from zero if positive, round towards zero if negative. Rest LGTM.
